description_en: Queries the instance status details of a change tracking channel. This is a legacy operation
description_zh: 老版查看订阅通道实例状态详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-subscription-instance-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsy0zz3t13h7d0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSubscriptionInstanceStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
